seamHistory.why: seam #3 (lgm, user-ordered): the width-table bounder answered matchesProperty(SVG)=false, so EmbeddedDiagram.java:129-152 reserved 42x42 for every {{ }} diagram; re-captured the fixtures with embedded diagrams only (EmbeddedDiagram is the sole StringBounder caller of matchesProperty(SVG)).

seam #4 (isw, user ruling 2026-10-08 lgm row 20): UnicodeFontWidthSansSerif block 0 gives U+0020 width 0, so under PLANTUML_DETERMINISTIC_TEXT every space was zero-wide and a lone-space UText crashed SlotFinder (Slot.java:44-45). Seam #4 adds 44 tenths per U+0020 (the table's own U+0021/U+00A0 advance; Helvetica/Arial agree); the whole oracle was re-captured one JVM per fixture (scripts/recapture-oracles.ts).

seam #4 v1 (spaces*4.4*size/16 added after the scaled sum) crashed the jar on activity cemagu-66/nerete-42/rosepa-78 (Direction.java:128 via Worm.mergeMe); amended in place to eb0f3cff7df (U+0020 measured as U+0021, width rounded to float like the stock bounder). Never re-captured into a merged oracle.

seam #5 (pbs, #170 ruling 2026-11-11): FileFormat.PNG's bounder was StringBounderAwt even under PLANTUML_DETERMINISTIC_TEXT, so rollback atoms (AtomMath.java:63-70) and wire print (WireDiagram.java:133) were sized by host AWT fonts
